title: Measures to mitigate fire spread to adjacent buildings during construction, with water supply and firefighting access
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: March 2025 (platform created March 14, 2025, last updated March 14, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies requirements for measures to mitigate fire spread to adjacent buildings, water supply and access for firefighting.
These measures must consider the size, type and configuration of the project, the methods of construction or demolition, and the distance to and stage of completion of adjacent exposures.
The owner, developer or contractor must submit the mandatory fire safety plan to the AHJ before construction, alteration or demolition begins.
The owner, developer or contractor must ensure the fire department has unobstructed access to the site and that water supply for firefighting is sufficient.
There is no single solution that is appropriate for all projects.
